contracts.boundary: Validate committed PR candidate evidence locally against the explicit target base before pushing.
contracts.assertions: The pre-push CLI rejects missing or stale bases, dirty tracked files and uncommitted declarations, and detects undeclared committed changes.

boundaryTest.name: pre-push validates a committed candidate against an explicit base

invariant.name: exits 0 with the passed report and exits 1 on a stale diff report

fault.exception: The named CLI boundary test directly exercises rejected dirty, stale and uncovered candidates; a separate injected fault duplicates the same boundary control.
